description: Defines structures, flags, and functions for iterating over directory trees, including recursive traversal, filtering, and sorting options.

methods.name: dir_iterator_begin
methods.description: Initializes a directory iterator for a given path with specified flags, returning a pointer to the iterator or NULL on failure.

methods.name: dir_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the directory iterator to the next entry, returning ITER_OK if successful, ITER_DONE if iteration is complete, or ITER_ERROR on error.

methods.name: dir_iterator_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the directory iterator.
